querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      ann_dt,
                                      report_period,
                                      oper_rev,
                                      oper_profit,
                                      tot_profit,
                                      net_profit_excl_min_int_inc,
                                      tot_assets,
                                      tot_shrhldr_eqy_excl_min_int,
                                      eps_diluted,
                                      roe_diluted,
                                      s_isaudit,
                                      yoynet_profit_excl_min_int_inc,
                                      brief_performance,
                                      memo,
                                      s_fa_bps,
                                      s_fa_yoysales,
                                      s_fa_yoyop,
                                      s_fa_yoyebt,
                                      s_fa_yoynetprofit_deducted,
                                      s_fa_yoyeps_basic,
                                      s_fa_roe_yearly,
                                      s_fa_growth_assets,
                                      s_fa_yoyequity,
                                      growth_bps_sh,
                                      last_year_oper_rev,
                                      last_year_oper_profit,
                                      last_year_tot_profit,
                                      last_year_net_profit_excl_inc,
                                      last_year_eps_diluted,
                                      s_early_net_assets,
                                      s_early_bps,
                                      actual_ann_dt,
                                      performexp_npdedtoshareholder,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_ashareprofitexpress.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.ashareprofitexpress WHERE report_period BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
